lotId.description: ID of the lot: the smallest listing key in it.

projectKey.description: Project key; joins lots, projects and listings.

floor.description: The unit's floor, from a listing's description; null when no listing names it.

sizeSqm.description: Size in m² (median of the listings).

advertisers.description: Different advertisers among them, by the signature in the description (an estimate).

minPrice.description: Lowest asking price of the unit, in THB.

priceSpreadPercent.description: How much the highest price is above the lowest, in percent.

minPricePerSqm.description: Lowest price per m², in THB.

vsProjectMedianPercent.description: The lowest price per m² against the project's typical asking price per m², in percent; below zero is cheaper.

cheapestUrl.description: Link to the cheapest listing of the unit.

sharedPhotos.description: Photos the listings share: the same file or nearly the same picture (marketing renders and common-area photos not counted).

offers.description: Every listing of the unit: link, price, advertiser signature, posted date and days listed.

confidence.description: high: two or more shared photos; medium: one, which can also be a render used by two listings of different units.

onMarketSince.description: Earliest day any agency listed this unit.

lastActivityAt.description: Latest day an agency posted this unit or changed its price.

daysSinceActivity.description: Days since an agency last posted the unit or changed its price.

freshness.description: How recently any agency did something with the unit: fresh (posted or repriced within 60 days), aging (within 180 days) or stale (older): agencies rarely take down sold units, so a stale listing may be gone.

offersRemoved.description: Listings of this unit taken down since the last run while other agencies still offer it: the unit may be sold.

lastOfferRemovedAt.description: Last day a removed listing of this unit was seen.

nearestStation.description: Nearest BTS, MRT or Airport Rail Link station (Bangkok), from the listing page or estimated.

nearestStationKm.description: Distance to the nearest station, in km.
